rules.title: Rent Increase Limit
rules.requirement: In properties subject to rent control, landlords cannot increase rent by more than the applicable CPI percentage posted or 4%, whichever is lower.
rules.citation: § 260-3 of the Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: § 260-3 of the Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance prohibits property owners from imposing or collecting a rent increase greater than the applicable percentage posted or 4%, whichever is less, in properties that are subject to rent control.
